exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Have you done much travelling? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you think it's better to travel alone or with other people? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Where would you like to travel in the future? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a child that you know. You will have to talk about the topic for one to two minutes. You should say: who this child is and how often you see him or her; how old this child is; what he or she is like; and explain what you feel about this child.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: How much time do children spend with their parents in your country? Do you think that is enough?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: How important do you think spending time together is for the relationships between parents and children? Why?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Have relationships between parents and children changed in recent years? Why do you think that is?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: What are the most popular free-time activities with children today?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Do you think the free-time activities children do today are good for their health? Why is that?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: How do you think children's activities will change in the future? Will this be a positive change?
